deploy.startCommand: sh -lc 'case "${AI_ROLE:-consumer}" in consumer) AI_METRICS_BIND=0.0.0.0 AI_CONSUMER_METRICS_PORT=${PORT} exec /opt/venv/bin/python -u cmd/consumer/main.py ;; user_embed) AI_METRICS_BIND=0.0.0.0 AI_USER_EMBED_METRICS_PORT=${PORT} exec /opt/venv/bin/python -u cmd/user_embed_consumer/main.py ;; ac) AI_METRICS_BIND=0.0.0.0 AI_AC_CONSUMER_METRICS_PORT=${PORT} exec /opt/venv/bin/python -u cmd/ac_consumer/main.py ;; user_rematch) AI_HEALTH_PORT=${PORT} exec /opt/venv/bin/python -u cmd/user_rematch_consumer/main.py ;; *) echo "unknown AI_ROLE=${AI_ROLE}" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
